precision_constraints: Saturated object is the retained reference Mram=M intersect Vram inside G.M; NuLat is generally not saturated.
The Mna-to-M stabilizer sandwich e remains in tauP. Saturation changes its rank multiplier, not its value.
SR exact tail is rho*S*(product(1+m*kappa)-1); removing rho from the io allowance uses actual rank/size hypotheses, not saturation alone.
At own type prime T>=Xprime, VV is empty and tau=io=0; the unchanged exceptional excess B is justified there. New exceptional nonzero baselines require redefinition.
Actual NuLat constructor is ExistsLedPart.exists_lat -> setLat -> exists_ledPart. NZColD/F/G generic construction is not asserted to be the final witness.
Rank formula does not establish the actual metric identity. LC7 is still a model calculation until integral/isometric transport is supplied.
Ideal floors are taken after ramification scaling and finite-place gains may be negative.
AG uses f complex-conjugate representatives and sqrt(N ideal) in product norm; packing dimension is 2f.
Finite spectral word sets come from bounded closure of finite probability supports for finite cutoffs, not finiteness of all real spectral letters.
No lower final RH exponent or newly replayed Lean improvement is claimed.
GRH scope is all Dirichlet L-functions; not unrestricted Dedekind or automorphic GRH.
A_r and determinant twist can be negative. Pairing is phi(p^A_r x), with w^2=p; never replace p^A by w^A.
SY other chart means different rational plane, not merely a different matrix basis of the same plane.
SY raw integral realization F_o differs from rational symbol preimage f_o. For o>T both may be zero.
SY key error coefficient bound uses integrality before normal scaling. Residual determinant exponents stay nonnegative; no determinant is inverted in the integral lift.
SY Frobenius exponent calculation translates all finite lifted positions by a common nPrime multiple before using natural powers.
CL primitive proof needs saturation of span(B), nonzero SPtrue mod w and monic distinct leading terms.
CL contraction scalar c need not be a unit; divisibility transfer is x(cb)=p^(kappa+DX).
CL operator-word simplification is over characteristic-zero fields only; it does not replace the integral Weyl comparison or AG archimedean spectral-word estimates.
The numerical 54 is a valid large-threshold witness extraction, not a removal of the underlying constrained-test input.
GH total evenness does not force c=1; parity of the two-primary component enters after the odd component is killed.
GH Fourier identity is stated on units; primitive representatives require ramified-prime corrections.
GH fixed q,d precede x; only e(x/kappa) varies within the window.
Incoming MemAt and outgoing MembAt are different. DT10 proves the latter pointwise; IN/WT now prove the former for the actual word family.
IP basis is integral and adapted to prefix filtrations, not an integral direct sum of rational isotypic lattices. All-prime independence plus counting gives determinant ±1.
IP Frobenius key proof retains actual finite faithful Witt-DVR hypotheses, N+r<=K, even nPrime and strict lifted-position gaps.
IW Fock form is symmetric bilinear and normalized by F(H,H), not a chosen unit. Exact lattice convention is det(A)^(-lambda_k)R(A^(-1))nabla.
IW4 h bounds the same coordinate across TWO representation weights; for signed polynomials h=2 degIn is safe. It is not a coordinate spread within a single Hom weight.
Standalone PG permits arbitrary ramification; w^2=p is needed only in the actual local application and the DT normal scalar construction.
PG R=0 removes its auxiliary remainder only. Normal/digit approximation errors remain, and global constant 54 is unchanged.
DT factorial approximation has integral binomial coefficients, total degree <=2(c−1), and works for every prime; source 4c/6c bounds and downstream constants are preserved.
DT10 proves DecAt/AlgAt/DegAt/LabAt under exact MFH/Tied/BlockOK/NormTest/YY and phi-degree hypotheses. It does not manufacture the complete numerical datum.
IN uses the exact blocked PlanePairsOnBlocksAt/MemAtB -> Lemma5aAt route; the stronger uninstantiated Lemma5aGeneratorProductsAt is neither needed nor claimed proved.
IN does not treat X->X^(p^g) as a characteristic-zero GL intertwiner. The lab-coefficient expansion and exact Fdig identity supply the required transport.
IN BlockDeg cancels the actual localizer degree against the base quotient degree. Removing that constraint would invalidate the link estimate.

WT bounds the number of operators per physical position by c0, not the total word length by c0. The intermediate link bound 1/4 is stronger than the retained source 3/8; downstream constants are unchanged.
CB invariance is a polynomial identity in a generic column-addition parameter, not just invariance at finite-field points. The proof works over every domain and introduces no lattice denominators.
CB exact complementary n2 / FewBadOrbits dimension is distinct from the selected-symbol rank target in SD8.
SD RestSel provides an actual-generator direct summand of rank equal to reduced-span dimension; it does not estimate that dimension.
SD3 proves multiplier nonvanishing, not GeneratorModuloUniformiser. Its determinant factors are separately nonzero; a common identity evaluation is unnecessary.
SD7 loss compression requires a positive target 1-Nr^2k/Y; a nonpositive final rank target is handled by rank>=0, not by multiplying possibly negative factor bounds.

LA periodic wrap uses the actual representative x-n' where required. The decoder includes the actual shifted degree data and the exact adjacent carry ratio, rather than assuming each full segment is disjoint modulo the period.
GP counting assumes AdmLL; membership and rank comparison additionally require BOK. Idx(j,restr b)=Idx(j,b) because the old-frame path degrees use Bw-m independently of the old values of b.

RS multiplies lower factors only in the positive-target case; if the final target is nonpositive, nonnegative rank proves the result directly. The unchanged earlier SD7 constraint still applies.
